database_summary: Analytical/operational mix containing weekly sales (raw + cleaned), customer shopping cart events and users, bitcoin members/transactions/prices, interest metrics and mapping, and multiple vegetable transaction/wholesale/category/loss tables. Data includes event streams (shopping_cart_events, bitcoin_transactions, veg_txn_df), periodic measures (weekly_sales, cleaned_weekly_sales, interest_metrics, bitcoin_prices), master/dimension-like tables (shopping_cart_users, bitcoin_members, customer_regions, shopping_cart_page_hierarchy, interest_map, shopping_cart_event_identifier, shopping_cart_campaign_identifier, veg_cat, veg_loss_rate_df) and node/membership history (customer_nodes). Several tables are likely pre-cleaned duplicates (weekly_sales vs cleaned_weekly_sales).

accepted.name: weekly_sales_raw_norm
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  week_date,
  region,
  platform,
  segment,
  customer_type,
  CAST(transactions AS INTEGER) AS transactions,
  CAST(sales AS INTEGER) AS sales
FROM weekly_sales
accepted.description: Normalized raw weekly_sales with numeric casts and preserved dimension columns. Use when cleaned_weekly_sales is not available or to compare raw vs cleaned data. | Use for: validate differences between raw and cleaned weekly sales; aggregate weekly sales into monthly/yearly summaries when cleaned version unavailable

accepted.name: shopping_cart_events_enriched
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  e.visit_id,
  e.cookie_id,
  e.page_id,
  p.page_name,
  p.product_category,
  p.product_id,
  e.event_type,
  ei.event_name,
  e.sequence_number,
  e.event_time
FROM shopping_cart_events e
LEFT JOIN shopping_cart_page_hierarchy p ON e.page_id = p.page_id
LEFT JOIN shopping_cart_event_identifier ei ON e.event_type = ei.event_type
accepted.description: Event-level shopping cart stream joined to page and event name dimensions. Preserves event identifiers and exposes page_name and event_name for easier analytics and funnels. | Use for: session funnel analysis (page sequences, drop-off by page/event); event counts by page_name or product_category; time-to-event or event ordering using sequence_number and event_time

accepted.name: shopping_cart_users_cookie_map
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  user_id,
  cookie_id,
  start_date
FROM shopping_cart_users
accepted.description: Mapping of shopping_cart_users rows: preserves user to cookie relationships and start_date for joining event streams to known users. | Use for: attribute events to known users using cookie_id; cohort analyses by user start_date

accepted.name: bitcoin_txn_enriched
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  t.txn_id,
  t.member_id,
  m.first_name,
  m.region,
  t.ticker,
  t.txn_date,
  t.txn_type,
  CAST(t.quantity AS REAL) AS quantity,
  CAST(t.percentage_fee AS REAL) AS percentage_fee,
  t.txn_time
FROM bitcoin_transactions t
LEFT JOIN bitcoin_members m ON t.member_id = m.member_id
accepted.description: Bitcoin transactions joined to member profile to expose member attributes (e.g., region) alongside transaction details. Useful for member-level and region-level transaction aggregations. | Use for: volume and fees by member or region; trade counts and quantities by ticker and txn_type

accepted.name: bitcoin_prices_normalized
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  ticker,
  market_date,
  CAST(price AS REAL) AS price,
  CAST(open AS REAL) AS open,
  CAST(high AS REAL) AS high,
  CAST(low AS REAL) AS low,
  volume,
  change
FROM bitcoin_prices
accepted.description: Normalized bitcoin_prices where numeric price/open/high/low are cast to REAL and textual volume/change are preserved as-is (parsing left to consumer). Use as canonical price series for joining to transactions by market_date and ticker. | Use for: join latest price to transactions by date; compute returns or vwap after parsing volume/change

accepted.name: customer_transactions_by_customer
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  customer_id,
  txn_type,
  COUNT(*) AS txn_count,
  SUM(CAST(txn_amount AS INTEGER)) AS txn_amount_sum
FROM customer_transactions
GROUP BY
  customer_id,
  txn_type
accepted.description: Aggregated customer transaction totals per customer and transaction type: counts and sum of amounts. Useful for customer-level activity and LTV-style calculations. | Use for: customer activity summaries (deposits/withdrawals) by customer; identify heavy transactors or aggregate by customer segment when joined to customer_nodes

accepted.name: interest_metrics_timekey
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  _month,
  _year,
  month_year,
  interest_id,
  CAST(composition AS REAL) AS composition,
  CAST(index_value AS REAL) AS index_value,
  CAST(ranking AS INTEGER) AS ranking,
  CAST(percentile_ranking AS REAL) AS percentile_ranking
FROM interest_metrics
accepted.description: Normalized interest_metrics with explicit integer year and month columns and preserved identifiers; makes month/year arithmetic easier for time-series comparisons. | Use for: trend analysis of interest index_value or composition over months/years; rank-based selections when combined with interest_map

accepted.name: veg_transactions_base
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  "index",
  txn_date,
  txn_time,
  item_code,
  CAST("qty_sold(kg)" AS REAL) AS "qty_sold(kg)",
  CAST("unit_selling_px_rmb/kg" AS REAL) AS "unit_selling_px_rmb/kg",
  "sale/return",
  CAST("discount(%)" AS INTEGER) AS "discount(%)",
  day_of_week
FROM veg_txn_df
accepted.description: Normalized vegetable transactions with preserved item_code and numeric casts for quantity and unit price. Useful for sales, loss-rate, and category analyses. | Use for: compute kilograms sold and revenue by item; join to veg_cat and veg_loss_rate_df for margin/loss analysis

accepted.name: veg_item_master
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  c.item_code,
  c.item_name,
  c.category_code,
  c.category_name,
  l."loss_rate_%" AS "loss_rate_%"
FROM veg_cat c
LEFT JOIN veg_loss_rate_df l ON c.item_code = l.item_code
accepted.description: Vegetable item master joining category and loss-rate info per item_code. Keeps item_code, item_name, category and loss rate for cross-analysis with transactions. | Use for: attach category and loss rate to transaction-level veg rows; compute effective sellable quantity after loss

accepted.name: shopping_cart_session_sequences
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  visit_id,
  cookie_id,
  page_id,
  event_type,
  sequence_number,
  event_time,
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY visit_id ORDER BY sequence_number, event_time) AS visit_event_row_number
FROM shopping_cart_events
accepted.description: Assigns row_number per visit ordered by sequence_number and event_time (if available). Use to identify first/last event in a visit and to deduplicate events when needed. | Use for: identify first/last event per visit; deduplicate or select canonical event when duplicates exist

accepted.name: customer_nodes_active
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  customer_id,
  region_id,
  node_id,
  start_date,
  end_date
FROM customer_nodes
WHERE end_date IS NULL OR end_date > date('now')
accepted.description: Filter of customer_nodes to currently-active node assignments where end_date IS NULL or in the future. Useful for joining customers to their current region/node membership. | Use for: current membership lookups for customers; join to customer_regions for region names
